race.description: Panthers Port Macquarie Country Boosted Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: COSMIC JINKS (11) brings a solid SP profile and can get the better of these from the right gate. Covered plenty of ground in the run with a gritty second as fav over 1004m at this track. No excuses today. COMMEDIA (5) resumes. Returned from a let-up and failed to handle the heavy conditions with a poor seventh over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Has switched to the Todd Payne stable and has the ability to overcome the sticky draw. MISS COMO (6) resumes after struggling on the rain affected tracks when last in work. Snagged back from the wide gate and never got into the contest on the heavy surface when seventh over 1262m at Taree last May. Has a good fresh record and maps well. SAMOGON (10) Russian Revolution gelding out of Mezcal on debut for the Todd Howlett yard. Had plenty of trials in readiness for this and can take a hand in the finish.
